user.title: Connect to BombeCam
user.description: Enter the address of the BombeCam gateway (for example http://192.0.2.10:8654) and the administrator credentials. No manual token: the gateway mints one for you.

reauth_confirm.title: BombeCam sign-in required
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {url} rejected the stored sign-in. Enter the administrator name and password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway; check the address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The config entry no longer exists.

shadow_readback_failed.title: Camera controls will not respond
shadow_readback_failed.description: Camera settings are not reporting back. The camera stream may still work, but switch and select states will stay unknown. Check the BombeCam logs.
